title: Model channel-fit heatmap and partner-sourcing playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Produce a pragmatic heatmap and operational scorecard that maps open and licensed model variants to go-to-market channels (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private) and to partner readiness (quantization/tooling support, licensing constraints, hardware affinity). Deliver a partner-sourcing playbook with sourcing triggers, vendor evaluation template, and a prioritized list of 6 recommended model/partner combos for Q2 procurement pilots.

Context: PM & Sales teams are seeing increasing requests for specific model capabilities tied to deployment modes (e.g., customers asking for 8-bit quantization on-prem, or permissive licenses for internal-fine-tuning). We need an evidence-backed, repeatable process to evaluate model families across product channels and to recommend partner/vendor pairings that minimize integration effort and inference cost risk.

Deliverables:
- Channel-Fit Heatmap (spreadsheet + dashboard): model families vs channels, scored on performance, infra-fit, license risk, and anticipated unit cost delta.
- Partner Scorecard (CSV + doc): scoring rubric for potential partners (hardware/cloud partners, model vendors, quantized-build maintainers).
- Partner-sourcing Playbook (Confluence page): steps, roles, gating criteria, procurement triggers, legal flags, and a lightweight NDA checklist.
- 6 prioritized model-partner combos for Q2 pilot (rationale and risk notes).

Why this matters: Aligns product, solutions, and sales around a single truth for which models are realistic for each channel. Reduces repeated ad-hoc evals and shortens procurement cycles for enterprise deals that require dedicated/private deployments.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Heatmap completed with at least 12 model variants evaluated across the three channels and populated scores for performance, cost delta, license risk, and infra compatibility.
2) Partner scorecard includes at least 8 partner profiles and a documented scoring rubric.
3) Playbook pages linked in Confluence with clear gating criteria and an example procurement trigger.
4) Stakeholder review completed: Product, Solutions Eng, Legal, and Sales have provided sign-off comments in the Confluence page.
5) 6 prioritized pilot combos submitted with feasibility notes and cost range estimates.
